label: D1-only update gate, mid-episode (trials ~10-60), with a2-leaning policy and recent reward
explanation: Fires only at D1 (fixation) steps; never at GO or D2. Strongly tied to episode time: almost all activity falls in episode trials 10-59 (peak 20-39), essentially none after trial 70 or before trial 3, and correspondingly only in a narrow mid band of the value head (7.13-7.73). Within that, it prefers a policy leaning toward a2 (choice logit < -1.5; prev/next action a2, good=S2 lifts) and a rewarded previous trial (in_rew=1 holds 82% of mass). Magnitude builds up over consecutive rewarded D1s in a streak (e.g. 0.19 -> 0.72 -> 0.91 -> 0.96 over successive trials) rather than tracking any single trial outcome. Recorded predicate uses only observed/internal quantities (phase, episode time, the model own policy logit). Precision is limited: many mid-episode a2-leaning D1 steps are inactive, so the feature likely encodes a graded slow state (episode-time / value plus choice bias) in its magnitude. D1 & ep_trial 10-59 alone gives mass recall 0.93 at F1 0.41.
